metadata.description: English web-fiction writing toolkit — market scanning, book deconstruction, and full writing workflows for long-form and short-form novels

plugins.name: story
plugins.description: Story writing toolkit main entry. Routes market-scan, deconstruction, and writing tools, and can launch the local writing desk via /story dashboard.

plugins.name: story-long-scan
plugins.description: Long-form market scanning. Analyzes ranking data from English platforms (Royal Road, Webnovel, Amazon Kindle) to surface trends and hot genres.

plugins.name: story-long-analyze
plugins.description: Long-form deconstruction. Deep-dives blockbuster long-form novels: opening hook chapters, character architecture, payoff design, pacing.

plugins.name: story-long-write
plugins.description: Long-form writing. From outline to prose, supports worldbuilding, characters, and plot-line management for serialized novels.

plugins.name: story-short-scan
plugins.description: Short-form market scanning. Analyzes English short-fiction platforms (Wattpad, Inkitt, Radish, Galatea) for emotional-market trends.

plugins.name: story-short-analyze
plugins.description: Short-form deconstruction. Breaks down viral short stories: hooks, reversals, emotional beats, genre formulas.

plugins.name: story-short-write
plugins.description: Short-form writing. From concept to finished short story, focused on emotional pull and serialization craft.

plugins.name: story-deslop
plugins.description: De-AI-flavoring. Detects and removes AI-writing fingerprints so prose reads naturally.

plugins.name: browser-cdp
plugins.description: Control a Chrome browser via CDP for scraping and logged-in sessions.

plugins.name: story-setup
plugins.description: Deploys the writing environment: hooks, custom agents, and references for Claude Code / OpenCode / Codex / ZCode / OpenClaw / Reasonix / generic.

plugins.name: story-review
plugins.description: Multi-perspective adversarial review of manuscripts with platform rubrics and consistency checks.

plugins.name: story-import
plugins.description: Reverse-import existing novels: parse finished or half-finished books into project structure for continuation.

plugins.name: story-cover
plugins.description: Cover generation. Analyzes title/author/genre and prompts GPT-Image for a fitting cover.
